subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should the broader performance audit retain this disproven route-contract extraction as a closed no-go branch, or sponsor a distinct measured hypothesis for reducing shared route-entry closure?
rationale: The first bounded experiment produced no improvement and was reverted; selecting another target or ending this audit branch is a roadmap tradeoff rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Archive the no-go branch
options.body: Retain the measurements under the umbrella audit and do not pursue further route-contract splitting without new evidence.

options.title: Sponsor a new measured target
options.body: Name one different import or route boundary and require baseline/candidate manifest and cold-navigation proof before broader refactoring.

recommendation.title: Archive the no-go branch
recommendation.body: Retain the measurements under the umbrella audit and do not pursue further route-contract splitting without new evidence.
